exact_auxiliary_statement: Every finite simple nonbipartite cubic graph of girth at least five, which is three-vertex-connected and has only trivial three-edge cuts, contains a pentagon.

proposal.blocker: Every finite simple nonbipartite cubic graph of girth at least five, which is three-vertex-connected and has only trivial three-edge cuts, contains a pentagon. This structural-only assertion fails for the explicitly B-mappable X_11 on 22 vertices; no conclusion is drawn about a hypothetical minimum non-B-mappable graph. The frozen graph is rechecked here and also avoids K2,3 (girth six).
